title: A filtered tree
description:
Show a tree where a search keeps matching nodes and their parents, and opens the path to them.

```
filter "sword":
  Items
    Weapons
      Iron sword
      Fire sword
(Armour and Potions hidden; Items and Weapons opened)
```
hints: A recursive function first checks the children, then decides: visible if the node matches or any child is visible (lesson 3.04).
In ImGui, `ImGui::SetNextItemOpen(true)` before `TreeNode` forces it open while filtering.
requirements: Nodes have a name and children (`std::vector<Node>`).
`filter(node, text)` returns whether the node or any descendant matches, ignoring case.
Build the list of visible rows with their depth and whether each must be forced open.
stretch: Keep each node's own open state and restore it when the filter is cleared.
